definitions.explanation: Formal advice or suggestion, often from an authority or official body urging a certain course of action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧{勧告|かんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: The government issued an evacuation advisory.

examples.japanese: {勧告|かんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}する→無視：13473_mushi⟧。
⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧{勧告|かんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。

notes:
{勧告|かんこく} is a formal recommendation or advisory, typically issued by an authority or official body. It carries more weight than casual advice but is not legally binding.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勧告|かんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to issue a recommendation
- {勧告|かんこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a recommendation
- {勧告|かんこく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow the recommendation
- ⟦{避難|ひなん}→避難：07908_hinan⟧{勧告|かんこく}: evacuation advisory
- ⟦{辞職|じしょく}→辞職：06157_jishoku⟧{勧告|かんこく}: recommendation to resign

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{忠告|ちゅうこく}→忠告：05462_chuukoku⟧: advice or warning (personal, from concern)
- ⟦{助言|じょげん}→助言：05461_jogen⟧: advice (neutral, professional)
- ⟦{提言|ていげん}→提言：17132_teigen⟧: proposal, suggestion (constructive, forward-looking)
- ⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: order, command (binding; stronger than {勧告|かんこく})

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in news, government announcements, and official documents.
